Refitting

1. Open the bonnet lid, then rotate the headlamp cover in an anti-clockwise direction and remove it.

2. Disconnect the electrical connection from the lamp.

3. Remove the retaining spring.

4. Extract the headlamp bulb.

If the lamp is working properly, avoid touching the bulb with your hands. If this does happen, clean the bulb with alcohol.

Removing

Refitting
  • Open the bonnet.
  • Rotate the cover retainer.
  • Remove the cover (2a) releasing the retainers (2b).

• Release the retaining clips.
  • Extract the bulb holder and bulb.
  • Extract the bulb from the bulb holder.

If the bulb is working properly, avoid touching it with your hands. If this does happen, clean the bulb with alcohol.

Refitting

Removing
  • Check the condition of the bulb and make sure that it is clean.

Avoid touching the bulb with your hands. If this does happen, clean the bulb with alcohol.

  • Fit the bulb in the bulb holder and fit the bulb holder attaching the retaining clips. The correct position for the bulb is illustrated.

• Position the cover and attach the retainers.
  • Check that the bulb is working.
